m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Malory, I can't believe it was you who sabotaged my armor...
...I drift in the sea of darkness. I fall endlessly in the under dark. I crash through the maze of thorns.
...what is this Horned Crown? Who places it upon my brow? Are you friend... or Froudling? I know that voice...
I have lost my king, my castle, my country. I have had more heartbreak in this life than there are stars in the sky...
...Dun Dara will be my new home. I will bother no one, and be troubled no more.
...to see one reclaim the Sword of Kings and return Avalon to light is my most fervent wish...
Malory, you can't do this! No king lives forever. Besides, I have a plan to twist him to our cause..
...look, Gamma, just give me the blasted book already! You know Merle said I aced every test so far. What harm could it do?
Give me the Horned Crown, Froudling. I've paid your price. Give it to me or face my wrath!
...this will heal your wounds, mighty King, clothing you with impenetrable armor! Wear the Horned Crown and find new life!
Look at this, Gamma. There is a spiral pattern to those distant stars. I knew I was right!
...you, child, are the brightest star I've ever met. Despite the recent tragedies, I hope you'll follow me to continue your studies.
...It is time to go, Gamma. Time to build our school and open the doors to the first class...
Don't mind them. Just old ghosts and broken memories.
Head through the caverns until you reach the Night Garden. You can't miss it.
Consult the Statues of Fate and then come find me over there.
Go forward until you reach the Night Garden. Consult the Statues of Fate. Watch out for Dragonspawn and Corpse Lanterns!
